newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh president to visit India, Australia.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh president to visit India, Australia.

text.p: Kazakh President Nursultan Nazarbayev will travel to the Indian capital Delhi on Monday and will visit Australia later this week, his press service said.
"The president will be in India until December 11, after which he will fly to Australia," presidential spokesman Alexander Ivanov said in Almaty, capital of the Central Asian state.
Nazarbayev will seek to put the resource-rich former Soviet republic of 16.9 million people on the map for investors.
